metadata.name: Lake Constance Total‑Phosphorus Measurements (1951‑2010)
metadata.description: Total phosphorus (TP, µg L⁻¹) measurements from the Lake Constance Fischbach‑Uttwil site (47.6240037651 N, 9.3754994815 E). The dataset contains 104 records spanning 1951‑01‑01 to 2010‑12‑31, derived from the integer Year obs column (the Date/Time column is empty). Each record includes a surface depth (Depth top = 0 m) and a bottom depth of either 20 m (shallow) or 250 m (deep), with corresponding water depth values and a seasonal description (winter mixing vs. summer months). Constant metadata columns are Event, Latitude, Longitude, and Elevation (‑252 m).
